<thought>We need to create an ML‑ready dataset from the consolidated polymorphs JSON. The tool `prepare_tabular_dataset` will generate the required train and test files (and likely a feature list) in the specified output directory. After running it, we will list the output directory to see the exact filenames, then create a metadata JSON containing the list of features, and the paths to the train and test files. Finally we will return the path to this metadata JSON file.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_1/consolidated_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_1/nitride_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}
</action_input>
